title: studio.segmentation config
description: Workspace config for the segmentation plugin. All keys are optional; `recipes` adds to (or overrides by name) the defaults below.

metaEndpoint.description: Another Responses-compatible SAM deployment (egress to its host must be granted).

recipes.description: Prompt recipes: a label that turns into prompts sized to each image, without anyone looking at it. Pass the recipe's name as `label` with no prompts. Each mask is labelled with its box's name. Text prompts don't work on radiographs; use a recipe (boxes) there.

appliesTo.description: The kind of image the boxes fit.

boxesRel.description: Boxes as fractions of the image's width and height: [x0, y0, x1, y1].

names.description: One label per box, in order.
